About UniPOS

Software built for the way your business works.

UniPOS was created with one simple goal: to make powerful business software accessible, practical, and easy to use. We combine modern technology with a deep understanding of real business workflows to create solutions that help businesses manage sales, inventory, customers, employees, and operations more efficiently.

From a single store to growing multi-location businesses, UniPOS provides reliable software — and when your business needs something unique, we build it specifically for you.

Questions

Before you switch registers.

None, if you don't want it — UniPOS runs on any tablet or laptop. If you'd rather have a dedicated setup, we ship a reader, printer, and stand that pair in under a minute.

Yes. Sales, refunds, and inventory changes are stored locally the moment your connection drops, then sync automatically once you're back online — nothing gets lost or double-counted.

Import a spreadsheet from your current system, or photograph your shelf tags and UniPOS will build the catalog for you. Most shops are fully migrated in under twenty minutes.

No contracts. Cancel any time from your settings page, and export your full sales history whenever you like — it's your data.

You'll get a reminder five days before it ends. If you do nothing, your account simply reverts to the free Counter plan — no surprise charges.
